summary: Run snapshot recovery fixtures with their required root ownership and valid storage ancestry instead of silently skipping them on non-root CI runners.

guide.reason: Test-fixture permissions and forge execution change; no operator workflow changes.

api.reason: No runtime API change; the existing managed snapshot executor tests run with the ownership required by production storage validation.

roadmap.reason: Corrects test execution evidence without closing a milestone.

state.reason: Disposable test fixtures and local test binaries only; no product state.

verification.method: The two concurrency/restart fixtures failed under sudo before correction and passed afterward without skips. The exact mirrored forge-step commands then passed all 34 selected Snapshot tests with race instrumentation and root ownership, without skips. Native commands are simulated by the unit fixtures; no remote CI run was triggered. Independent workflow review confirmed both copies match and the GitHub.com exclusion remains intact.
